projects.title: Gold Trading Algorithm
projects.summary: Backtested algorithmic trading system for gold futures with Monte Carlo simulation, prop-firm analysis, and live Telegram signals.
projects.description: A fully backtested algorithmic trading system for gold futures (GC). It combines a rules-based entry/exit engine with Monte Carlo simulation to stress-test thousands of equity-curve scenarios, prop-firm rule analysis to validate drawdown and daily-loss limits, and a live Telegram bot that pushes real-time trade signals.
highlights: Monte Carlo stress-testing of the equity curve

projects.title: Crypto Price Tracker
projects.summary: Real-time cryptocurrency tracker with interactive charts and portfolio tracking via CoinGecko API.
projects.description: A real-time cryptocurrency price tracker with interactive Chart.js graphs and basic portfolio tracking, powered by the CoinGecko API.

projects.title: Triton Fused Softmax Kernel
projects.summary: Fused softmax GPU kernel in Triton — cuts DRAM traffic ~4× vs naive PyTorch by keeping all ops in on-chip SRAM.
projects.description: A custom fused softmax GPU kernel written in OpenAI's Triton. The kernel performs the max, exponentiation, and normalization passes entirely in on-chip SRAM, cutting DRAM traffic by roughly 4× compared to a naive PyTorch implementation. Autotuned across 11 matrix shapes via Triton's autotune over num_warps, num_stages, and BLOCK_SIZE to balance occupancy and memory throughput, and profiled on a T4 GPU with Nsight Compute to analyze occupancy, memory bandwidth utilization, and warp-stall reasons.
highlights: ~4× lower DRAM traffic vs naive PyTorch softmax
Autotuned across 11 matrix shapes (num_warps / num_stages / BLOCK_SIZE)
Profiled on T4 GPU with Nsight Compute for occupancy and warp-stall analysis

projects.title: LLM Inference Optimization (vLLM + AWQ + Speculative Decoding)
projects.summary: Llama 3.2 deployed on vLLM with AWQ 4-bit quantization, speculative decoding, and FP8 KV-cache benchmarking on an RTX 3070 Ti.
projects.description: End-to-end LLM inference optimization stack. Deployed Llama 3.2 3B on vLLM with AWQ 4-bit weight quantization to double the available context length on 8 GB VRAM. Implemented speculative decoding with a 1B draft model to reduce token generation latency while preserving output quality. Benchmarked TTFT and TPOT across KV-cache configurations using FP8 compression and PagedAttention on an RTX 3070 Ti.
highlights: AWQ 4-bit quantization doubled context length on 8 GB VRAM
Speculative decoding with 1B draft model reduced token latency
TTFT / TPOT benchmarked with FP8 KV-cache + PagedAttention on RTX 3070 Ti

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle Telemetry Pipeline
projects.summary: Real-time AV telemetry ingestion pipeline using Redpanda, Docker Compose, and MinIO for Kafka-compatible streaming and object storage.
projects.description: A real-time telemetry ingestion pipeline for autonomous-vehicle sensor data. Uses Redpanda to stream telemetry with Kafka-compatible producers and consumers, with the entire stack containerized via Docker Compose — Redpanda, MinIO, and Python services orchestrated as reproducible, isolated services. Raw telemetry is stored in MinIO object storage for structured retrieval of vehicle sensor logs.
highlights: Docker Compose stack: Redpanda + MinIO + Python services
MinIO object storage for raw sensor telemetry

projects.title: DeepFridge — Cross-Platform Fridge Inventory App
projects.summary: React Native + Supabase mobile app for fridge inventory with real-time multi-user sync, barcode scanning, and receipt capture.
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile app for fridge inventory management with real-time sync across shared devices via Supabase Realtime. Integrates Supabase Auth and shared-fridge functionality enabling multiple users to update the same fridge simultaneously. Multi-input entry — barcode scanning, receipt image capture, and manual entry — reduces friction for adding items.
highlights: Real-time multi-user sync via Supabase Realtime
Barcode scan, receipt capture, and manual entry

projects.title: GaitorGate — SFSU CSC648 Team Project
projects.summary: Full software engineering lifecycle project built with a 6-person team for SFSU's CSC648 software engineering course.
projects.description: A team-based software engineering course project at San Francisco State University (CSC648). Collaborated with a 6-person team across requirements gathering, design milestones, implementation, and shipping. Demonstrates team collaboration, version control workflows, and full-lifecycle delivery on a multi-developer codebase.

projects.title: Face Detection (OpenCV)
projects.summary: Real-time face detection using OpenCV — companion to the Hand Gesture project, demonstrating depth in classical computer vision.
projects.description: A real-time face detection application built with OpenCV. Captures webcam frames, runs classical face detection, and overlays bounding boxes on detected faces. Serves as a companion to the Hand Gesture project and demonstrates depth in OpenCV-based computer vision beyond a single demo.

projects.title: Voice Cloning with XTTS-v2
projects.summary: Voice cloning from a 6-second sample using Coqui XTTS-v2 deployed via Hugging Face.
projects.description: A voice cloning pipeline that synthesizes speech in a target voice from a 6-second reference sample. Built on Coqui's XTTS-v2 model deployed through Hugging Face, demonstrating Hugging Face model deployment and voice synthesis workflows.

projects.title: System Audio Capture (macOS)
projects.summary: Low-level macOS system audio capture using PyObjC, AppKit, FFmpeg, and the BlackHole driver.
projects.description: A macOS system audio capture tool built on low-level platform APIs. Uses PyObjC to bridge into AppKit, the BlackHole virtual audio driver to route system output, and FFmpeg to encode captured streams. Demonstrates depth in macOS system programming beyond standard cross-platform Python.

projects.title: Hugging Face Module

projects.description: A reusable Python wrapper module that abstracts common Hugging Face Transformers workflows behind a clean interface. Demonstrates the ability to package and structure code as a reusable module rather than one-off scripts.
highlights: Reusable wrapper around Hugging Face Transformers

projects.title: YouTube Audio + MP4 Downloader
projects.summary: Practical CLI utility for downloading YouTube audio and MP4 video via yt-dlp.
projects.description: A practical command-line utility that downloads audio tracks and MP4 video from YouTube using yt-dlp. Pairs naturally with the real-time audio recorder project for end-to-end audio workflows.

projects.title: Flask Server Starter

projects.description: A backend server starter built with Flask, exposing API endpoints and serving as a foundation for backend service work. Adds backend / API depth to a portfolio that's otherwise front-end and Python-script-heavy.

projects.title: Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK Notebook)

projects.description: A Jupyter notebook walking through natural-language processing workflows with NLTK — tokenization, tagging, parsing, and basic linguistic analysis. Closes the gap between the Natural Language Technologies coursework on the résumé and demonstrable work.

projects.title: LeetCode Solutions Archive

projects.title: STATBOARD — AI Sports Leaderboard

projects.title: Soccer Video Analysis Pipeline
projects.summary: ML pipeline using YOLO and SoccerNet to track players, detect behaviors, and analyze full 90-minute matches.
projects.description: An end-to-end machine-learning pipeline that ingests full 90-minute soccer matches, uses YOLO and SoccerNet data to detect and track players across frames, and surfaces behavioral and positional analytics for the whole match.

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle Simulation

projects.description: A desktop application that transcribes audio in real time using Python and the Whisper API. Multi-threaded audio capture keeps recording smooth while transcription runs concurrently.

projects.title: Police Data with Threads
projects.summary: Multi-threaded C program analyzing police response times across 500K+ records with mutex-protected critical sections.
projects.description: A multi-threaded C program that analyzes police response times across 500K+ records. It uses pthreads to parallelize statistical calculations and mutex locks to protect critical sections, demonstrating safe concurrent access and performance optimization.

projects.title: Roblox Survival Game

projects.description: A Roblox survival-tycoon game built in Luau inside Roblox Studio. It features procedural tower generation, custom character physics, and drop-zone mechanics that drive the core gameplay loop.

projects.description: A real-time, online multiplayer Uno card game built as a team project. It synchronizes live game state across players over WebSockets so every client stays in sync as cards are played.
